page.overview:
Who is Biokinton?

Biokinton, also known as Brokinton, is a boss in Super Mario Land.

Biokinton is an extremely shy creature who hides behind a cloud, obscuring his body, which has never been seen.

Biokinton appears in Super Mario Land as the fourth boss. Biokinton is in charge of the Chai Kingdom.

In battle, Biokinton attacks by throwing Chickens at Mario in the Sky Pop. To defeat Biokinton, Mario has to shoot missiles at him. After twenty hits, Biokinton is defeated, and Mario fights Tatanga in the same arena. Mario is awarded 5000 points for defeating Biokinton.
